verdict.rationale: The public docs describe a single-call, synchronous flow: upload a completed recording and receive the final transcript, plus detected languages, as JSON. A ready CLI command (`openai audio:transcriptions create`) also exists, so job creation and result retrieval collapse into one step with no human in between. The docs are agent-readable: there is an llms.txt hub and markdown versions of the docs pages. Missing for 10: the auth/API-key header is not explicitly documented in the evidence, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, the 25 MB limit is stated with no large-file or async path shown, and there is no hands-on confirmation of an agent completing the flow end to end.
